subject: CodeForge Hackathon — mentor microgrant & trial extension request
content:
From: Samira Khatri <samira@codeforge.org>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CodeForge Hackathon — mentor microgrant & trial extension request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for chatting on the call earlier. Quick follow-up from the CodeForge hackathon team — we'd love Redwood to support our mentor program. Two asks: a small microgrant for mentors (to be distributed as platform credits) and a short trial extension for hackathon participants so they can test integrations without running into quota issues.

Details:
- Hackathon dates: Dec 9–11 (virtual)
- Mentors: ~25 open-source maintainers/mentors (names attached)
- Ask: 1) 2,000-token credit per mentor (redeemable promo code) 2) 14-day trial extension for all registered participants (approx. 1,200 devs)
- Purpose: allow mentors to demo end-to-end flows and participants to run larger generation/embedding jobs during the event

Can Redwood approve this as an in-kind community partner grant? We can list Redwood as 'Mentor Sponsor' in event materials and give you a short keynote slot (5–7 min) on day 1.

Attached: CodeForge_Mentor_List.csv (names + bios).

Appreciate any guidance on promo code limits and whether the microgrant can be issued as individual promo codes vs. one-time bulk top-up.

Best,
Samira
Organizing Director, CodeForge

-----Original Message-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khatri <samira@codeforge.org>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CodeForge Hackathon — mentor microgrant & trial extension request

Samira — thanks for the clear note and the list. This is the kind of community work we love to support. I want to loop in Partnerships and Sales for a quick decision and to make sure we handle the promo code/billing side cleanly.

Looping in Marissa (Partnerships), Rishi (Sales ops), and Laura (Billing). Two quick Qs for you while we triage:
1) Do mentors need their credits tied to an email, or can we issue single-use codes?
2) Do you have an estimate for how many participants will actually redeem the trial extension (even a low estimate helps sizing)?

Jordan Blake
Head of Developer Partnerships
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Samira Khatri <samira@codeforge.org>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CodeForge Hackathon — mentor microgrant & trial extension request

Hi all — appreciate the ask and the event invite. Quick take:
- Microgrants: approve up to 2,000 tokens per verified mentor (we can do single-use promo codes tied to an email to prevent double-claims).
- Trial extension: approve a 14-day extension for registered participants, scoped to CodeForge registrant emails (we'll need a CSV upload with hashed emails for privacy).
- Logistics: Partnerships will provide the promo codes and marketing copy; Sales/Billing (Rishi/Laura) will handle redemption limits and reporting.

Marissa will send a short spec for PR/branding and credit wording. Two operational notes:
1) We need a signed partner acknowledgement (one-pager) — lightweight — with a clause limiting the total redemption to estimated numbers + 20% buffer.
2) We should attach terms that prevent reselling credits.

Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

> On Nov 24, 2026, at 11:45, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai> wrote:
>
> Jordan/Marissa — can you confirm expected redemption volume? For budgeting I want a hard cap (we can set buffer but need a commit). Also: is this considered a promotional credit (no cash value) for tax/finance? If so, finance will want a short memo.
>
> Rishi Malhotra
> Senior Sales Ops Manager

-----Original Message-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khatri <samira@codeforge.org>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CodeForge Hackathon — mentor microgrant & trial extension request

Hi Samira — good news: Partnerships has approved the microgrant in principle. For planning, Rishi asked for an estimate so we don't undershoot the cap. Can you confirm: what percentage of registrants typically redeem promos? If unknown, please share a conservative slot estimate (we'll size the buffer from that).

Samira replied inline later that day: "Historically ~12–18% of registrants redeem platform offers during the hackathon; mentors always redeem (we budget for that). For 1,200 registrants we expect ~200–220 redemptions, plus 25 mentors. We'll send the final CSV of mentor emails this Friday."

-----Original Message-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khatri <samira@codeforge.org>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CodeForge Hackathon — mentor microgrant & trial extension request

Samira — thanks for the redemption estimate and the mentor CSV (received).

Final operational plan:
- Mentors: 25 single-use, email-tied promo codes at 2,000-token value each. Codes attached in Redwood_Microgrant_Spec.pdf with redemption instructions.
- Participants: one-time global promo code for CodeForge registrants, 14-day trial extension. We'll create a bulk promo with a redemption cap of 300 to cover the buffer.
- Required assets from CodeForge: hashed CSV of registrant emails for opt-in validation and a signed partner acknowledgement (I attached promo-code-terms.txt; please sign and return).
- Reporting: we'll provide a post-event report (redemptions, top usage spikes) within two weeks after the event.

Samira — I'll follow up with DocuSign link for the acknowledgement and the promo codes once we get the signed file.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

> On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 15:02 Samira Khatri <samira@codeforge.org> wrote:
> Thanks, Laura — attaching signed acknowledgement now and the final mentor list. CodeForge is excited to feature Redwood in the opening keynote. See you at the hackathon!

[Attachment stubs: CodeForge_Mentor_List.csv (CSV), Redwood_Microgrant_Spec.pdf (PDF), promo-code-terms.txt (TXT)]
